notes.title: Freedom Tower Social Media Update — October 2023
notes.content:
Dear fellow Freedom Fighters,

We are delighted to announce that you can find us on Twitter and Discord!

We invite you to share the warmth of the campfire with the Tower fighters on the Discord server!

[url=https://discord.gg/FzHwvV3FPm][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/d5aea6036acbaae2fe0b6a10a863c3361ee8883b.png[/img][/url]

Furthermore, we will strive to share our ongoing work on Twitter. We'll be glad to see you among our allies!

[url=https://twitter.com/EternalGamedevs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44419092/8288644b3c56b1b5d0b8722e0cf0c04eb836563d.png[/img][/url]

The preproduction stage is reaching its zenith, and there will be many updates and backstage perks. 
Follow the light, stranger! It will surely lead you to the Tower!
